title: Workout library list (get_workouts)
description:
Returned by garminconnect's get_workouts(start, limit) — the account's workout library, newest first by createdDate (orderBy/orderSeq params are accepted but don't change the order). Consumed by sync_pending_workouts' _find_prior_upload, which looks for a workout an earlier timed-out upload_workout created by the description tag _queue_ref puts on every upload. Note the list item's timestamp is updateDate, while get_workout_by_id's is updatedDate.

Verified against: 2026-10-17, the full 7-workout library (all fields enumerated from it; a deleted workout is absent here and 404s from get_workout_by_id). Every field's observed type is allowed to be null too (except ids/names/createdDate), since types came from a small sample and Garmin nulls fields that don't apply (e.g. estimatedDistanceInMeters on a duration-only workout). Additional fields beyond what's listed here may exist and are tolerated (additionalProperties: true).

author.description: Real account PII (name, profile image) — never stored.

createdDate.description: UTC, no offset, e.g. "2026-10-17T15:47:43.0"; the list is ordered newest-first by this.

description.description: For a create_workout upload, "Queued by Waypoint · ref <queue item id>" (sync._queue_ref) — what _find_prior_upload matches on (verified 2026-10-17 to round-trip unchanged). Null for workouts built elsewhere.
